subject: Partial early renewal & staggered term swap — MSA + order form redline consolidation
messages:
From: Sam Reynolds <sreynolds@turnbridge.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Turnbridge Legal <contracts@turnbridge.io>
Date: Fri, 07 Jun 2029 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed redlines for partial early renewal + staggered term swap

Alex —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to move forward with a partial early renewal for Q4 capacity (roughly 40% of current committed tokens) while swapping a portion of the remaining term to a staggered schedule (18/12 months). Our legal team attached a clean set of suggested redlines to the MSA and a draft order form that reflects the split billing and proration.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm Redwood can commit to the 18/12 term split and that pricing tiers are locked for the first 12 months of each tranche.
- Add a limited early-cancellation carve-out for the partial renewal (our procurement wants a 30-day exit if regulatory review fails).
- Confirm retention/access controls for KV caches and that Turnbridge data will not be used for model improvements (we flagged the clause in section 5.2).

Attached: Turnbridge_MSA_redlines_20290607.pdf, OrderForm_SectionB_proposal.xlsx

Next steps: can you confirm internal alignment and share any hard no's by EOD Monday? We need to present this to procurement on Wed.

Best,
Sam
Director of Platform Partnerships
Turnbridge Analytics
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Reynolds <sreynolds@turnbridge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Jun 2029 10:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines for partial early renewal + staggered term swap

Sam — thanks for sending. Looping Karthik (legal ops) and Marissa (renewals) to triage the redlines. Quick confirmation from us up front:
- We can support an 18/12 staggered scheduling for the new tranche, but pricing lock needs to be scoped to the specific SKU lines in the order form (we'll reflect this in Exhibit B).
- Partial early-cancellation requests are sensitive; we need to scope the carve-out narrowly to cover regulatory blocks only and limit usage to the renewed tranche.
- Regarding data use: we can confirm no model training on Turnbridge data; we'll propose explicit language in section 5.2 and an accompanying security addendum (SOC2 + data handling).

@Karthik / @Marissa: could you review the attached redlines and call out any legal/finance blockers by Monday EOD? I can then propose a single consolidated mark and a short addendum for signature.

Alex
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Reynolds <sreynolds@turnbridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 08 Jun 2029 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines for partial early renewal + staggered term swap

Alex / Sam — I reviewed Turnbridge's PDF and the OrderForm spreadsheet. Inline summary (high level):

1) Pricing lock: acceptable if confined to SKU IDs TF-STD-202 and TF-BURST-40 for the first 12 months of each tranche. Suggest we add a clause: "Prices for SKUs listed in Exhibit B are fixed for twelve (12) months from effective date of that tranche."

2) Early-cancellation carve-out: we can accept a regulatory-failure exit limited to the renewed tranche only. Counter-proposal: add a 30-day cure (notice + remediation window) and cap refunds to unused pre-paid credits (no retroactive credits for previously consumed tokens).

3) Data use / training: add explicit no-training language and link to our Security Addendum (we will attach audit-proof artifacts — SOC2 report, KMS logs). Also propose a paragraph that prohibits both direct model training and any aggregation that could deanonymize Turnbridge customer data.

4) Billing/proration: the spreadsheet has a proration formula that looks correct; finance will validate the net present value of the staggered schedule. Need an explicit billing cadence clause (monthly invoices for tranche A, quarterly for tranche B) — please confirm billing preference.

5) Indemnity and limitation of liability: Turnbridge redlines seek broader indemnities. We can accept reputation-based indemnity but cannot accept open-ended consequential damages. Propose to keep standard mutual indemnities and add a small carve-out for regulatory fines tied to Redwood's negligence.

See attached: K_Iyer_comments_20290608.txt (embedded in my reply) — highlights inline comments against Turnbridge_MSA_redlines_20290607.pdf.

If Turnbridge is comfortable with the cure window and the refund cap, I think we can produce a consolidated mark and send to signatures within 48 hours.

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Legal Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Reynolds <sreynolds@turnbridge.io>
Date: Sun, 09 Jun 2029 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines for partial early renewal + staggered term swap

Team / Sam — commercial from my side is aligned on the tranche economics. A few operational clarifications we need in the order form before we consolidate:

- Capacity routing: need to ensure Turnbridge's Q4 reservation (the partial early renewal) is pinned to Dedicated pool A (us-west-2) to meet latency SLAs. Please confirm region preference.
- Overages: confirm the overage rate post-commit and whether overage will bill at TF-BURST-40 or at a separate surge line.
- Effective dates: we need explicit effective date stamps for Tranche A and Tranche B and a clause describing how the 18/12 overlap handles pro-rated days between the tranches.

Sam — if you can confirm region and overage preference I will finalize pricing tables and hand to Karthik for the final redline consolidation. If no objections, I'd like to send the consolidated mark + DocuSign envelope by Tuesday EOD so procurement can sign mid-week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Renewals Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Reynolds <sreynolds@turnbridge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines for partial early renewal + staggered term swap

Sam — appreciate the quick replies. Quick answers to Marissa's operational questions:
- Region: Turnbridge confirmed us-west-2 earlier on the call — we'll pin Tranche A to Dedicated pool A in us-west-2.
- Overages: Turnbridge prefers to keep overage at TF-BURST-40 rate; we will add a note that sustained overage triggers a conversation and potential re-pricing at next renewal.
- Effective dates: draft will show Tranche A effective 2029-10-01 for the early renewal, Tranche B to start 2029-12-01 (18-month). Proration language included.

Next steps: Karthik will produce a single consolidated PDF with the updated Exhibit B and the carve-out language for regulatory exit + 30-day cure. Marissa will finalize the pricing tables. We plan to send the DocuSign envelope by Tue EOD (link below) for procurement sign-off.

DocuSign (preview): https://app.docusign.com/recipient?envelopeId=abc-123-turnbridge
Drive (marks): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cTurnbridgeRenewal
